275456365.description:
Pressed Glass Insulator Lot - 12 Pieces
Whitall Tatum, Armstrong, and Pyrex
Aqua, Clear, and Smoky, Vintage 1920s-1950s
This collection features twelve vintage glass telephone and telegraph insulators from prominent American manufacturers. These pieces represent a significant era in telecommunications history, showcasing various industrial glass formulas including standard aqua, clear, and heat-resistant Pyrex borosilicate glass. Matching sets and mixed lots from these manufacturers are highly collectible for their industrial aesthetic and historical utility.
Pieces Included:
Whitall Tatum Co. No. 1, Aqua Glass - characteristic greenish-blue tint, molded manufacturer marks on base
Pyrex Clear Glass Insulator - high-clarity borosilicate glass, marked "Pyrex Reg. U.S. Pat. Off."
Armstrong "W" in Triangle Mark, Aqua Glass - produced after Armstrong's 1938 acquisition of Whitall Tatum
Armstrong T.W. Smoky/Clear Glass - industrial clear glass with age-appropriate tinting and molded date codes
Additional assorted aqua and clear pressed glass insulators to complete the 12-piece set
Condition:
The lot is in good vintage condition consistent with outdoor industrial use. Several pieces show characteristic rust staining near the thread interior and top grooves from contact with metal mounting brackets. No significant structural cracks observed. Minor fleabites and surface scratches may be present on rims or skirts. All molded lettering remains legible.

275834660.description: This lot includes a variety of natural mineral and gemstone specimens weighing 7.6 lbs. The collection primarily features several raw amethyst crystal clusters and geodes of various sizes, ranging from a few inches to over 8 inches across. The amethyst crystals exhibit rich purple hues, with some specimens containing calcite inclusions or iron oxide staining. Also included is a unique gemstone tree sculpture made with amethyst chips and copper wire, as well as a decorative piece with a metal Pegasus figurine mounted on an amethyst base. All items are in good used condition, showing natural variations and minor edge wear typical of mineral specimens.

275507928.description: This lot includes four assorted raw mineral gemstone specimens in natural, unpolished condition. It contains two pieces of black tourmaline with striated, columnar structures and dark metallic luster. There is one greenish fibrous mineral specimen, likely actinolite or a similar mineral. Also included is a large rough matrix rock with silvery metallic flecks, possibly containing pyrite or mica, showing gold and grey mineralization. All specimens exhibit typical surface texture, minor chips, and some adhering matrix material. Sizes range from small hand specimens to larger chunks. No branding or manufacturer information is present. These pieces are suitable for collectors, educational use, or metaphysical purposes.
